name: Wanted: Vile Priestess Hexx and Her Minions

meta.wiki: Wanted: Vile Priestess Hexx and Her Minions

summary: Primal Torntusk has ordered Vile Priestess Hexx and her minions brought to justice, and a grand prize awaits anyone who slays the priestess and her elite Aman'zasi guard. You will find them atop Jintha'alor in the Hinterlands.

sections.title: A Strike at Jintha'alor
sections.body: Primal Torntusk has ordered that Vile Priestess Hexx and her minions be brought to justice. The targets are the priestess herself and the Aman'zasi guards, her elite. Atop Jintha'alor, in the Hinterlands, is where they are found. Once they are slain, you report back to Torntusk at Revantusk Village.

faq.q: Who posted the bounty for Vile Priestess Hexx?
faq.answer: The call to arms was issued by order of Primal Torntusk, and a grand prize is offered to whoever slays the priestess and her guard.

faq.q: Where can Vile Priestess Hexx and her guards be found?
faq.answer: They are found atop Jintha'alor in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Who must be slain to fulfill the bounty?
faq.answer: The priestess Hexx herself, along with her Aman'zasi elite guard of the Vilebranch.

faq.q: Where is the bounty turned in?
aliases: where to turn in hexx bounty
faq.answer: Report to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village once the priestess and her guard are slain.
